environment.description: Same Apollo server deployed behind AWS ALB with listener on port 443. ALB target group forwards to port 4000 on private subnet EC2 instance. The ALB listener is configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) verification mode set to 'verify' against a custom trust store (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-123) containing only internally-issued client certificates. The trust store ARN is attached via ModifyListener with MutualAuthentication.Mode=verify and MutualAuthentication.TrustStoreArn. Connections without a valid client certificate from the internal CA receive HTTP 400 at the ALB layer before any traffic reaches the target. Security group on the EC2 instance only allows inbound from the ALB security group on port 4000. No public IP assigned to the instance. The x-forwarded-client-cert-dn header is populated by ALB only after successful mTLS handshake.

config.client_cert_issuance: internal PKI, requires employee identity verification and device attestation
